name: Australian National Aviation Museum

facts.claim: Aviation museum at Moorabbin Airport in Melbourne's south-east, founded in 1962 and run by volunteers
Known as the Australian National Aviation Museum until October 2021; now trades as the Moorabbin Air Museum
Collection includes the oldest surviving Commonwealth Aircraft Corporation aircraft, Wirraway A20-10, plus a Victa AirTourer and DAP aircraft
Address is 12 First Street, Moorabbin Airport

access_note: Renamed Moorabbin Air Museum in 2021; app name may want updating. Hours not recorded.

name: Grainger Museum

facts.claim: Repository on the life and music of composer and pianist Percy Grainger, University of Melbourne, Parkville
Opened December 1938; the only purpose-built autobiographical museum in Australia
Displays manuscripts, instruments, field recordings, artworks and personal items, plus Grainger's experimental 'Free music' sound devices

name: Ian Potter Museum of Art

facts.claim: University of Melbourne art museum at the corner of Swanston Street and Masson Road, Parkville
Reopened in 2025 under the shorter name Potter Museum of Art after a 2018-2025 hiatus
Changing exhibitions, currently 'Ngarn Wa'ngal: Art of the gum tree' (to 21 Nov 2026)
Admission is free

access_note: Now named Potter Museum of Art; exhibitions are temporary so bio should not name one.

name: Victoria Police Museum

facts.claim: Police museum run by Victoria Police, reopened in a new space on 25 September 2023
Now at the Victoria Police Centre, 313 Spencer Street, Docklands
Holds Australia's largest collection of Kelly Gang armour
Covers notorious Melbourne crimes, police equipment and forensic evidence
Entry is free

name: Royal Botanic Gardens Cranbourne

facts.claim: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria's Cranbourne site at Ballarto Road and Botanic Drive, Cranbourne
Centred on the Australian Garden, with the Red Sand Garden and a Eucalypt Walk of only Australian plants
Haven for endangered southern brown bandicoots
Open daily except Christmas Day; admission free

access_note: Paid extras only (Explorer bus tour); entry free.

name: McClelland Gallery and Sculpture Park

facts.claim: Sculpture park and gallery at 390 McClelland Drive, Langwarrin, in bushland on Bunurong Country
Has a cafe and design store; open Wednesday to Sunday
Galleries close between exhibitions while the sculpture park stays open

access_note: Adult $15; Frankston City postcodes free on weekdays and $5 adult on weekends; galleries occasionally closed for changeover. No Wikipedia article found under the draft title.
